notes.title: New Discord Server for Khaos Wind
notes.content:
Hey Khaos Wind fans, 

thank you so much for buying my first game Khaos Wind!  

If you want to talk to me directly you can find me on the new Discord Server I will try to make it a point to check in everyday under the username ElGatitoTheBugSlayer. 

I want to hear all of your thoughts about Khaos Wind!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/ERGPyA

Thank you!
